permissions.description: Handy Plus needs a couple of permissions to work properly.

rescan.tooltip: Rescan for models added to the models folder or Hugging Face cache outside Handy Plus

pauseMediaWhileRecording.label: Pause Music While Recording
pauseMediaWhileRecording.description: Pause Spotify when recording starts and resume it from the same spot when you stop
pauseMediaWhileRecording.denied: Handy Plus is not allowed to control Spotify. Grant it in System Settings > Privacy & Security > Automation.
pauseMediaWhileRecording.notRunning: Spotify is not running. Start it, then switch this on again to grant permission.
pauseMediaWhileRecording.unsupported: Pausing music is only available on macOS.
pauseMediaWhileRecording.failed: Could not reach Spotify. Music will keep playing while you record.

autostart.description: Automatically start Handy Plus when you log in to your computer.

showTrayIcon.description: Display the Handy Plus icon in the system tray.

keepAudioRecordings.label: Keep Audio Recordings
keepAudioRecordings.description: Save the audio for each dictation alongside its text. Turn off to keep searchable transcript history without storing audio files, saving disk space.

correctionPairs.title: Personal Dictionary
correctionPairs.description: Teach spelling corrections for names and terms that keep getting mis-transcribed. Add pairs directly here, or edit a transcript in History and confirm the suggested correction.

audioNormalization.label: Normalize quiet audio
audioNormalization.description: Lifts quiet recordings toward a usable level before transcription. Only boosts — audio that is already loud enough is left untouched.

discourseFillers.label: Remove "you know" and "I mean"
discourseFillers.description: Drops these two phrases when you used them as filler — that is, when a pause follows them. "Do you know the answer" and "I mean it" are left alone. English only.

export.title: Export transcripts

formats.markdown: Markdown — grouped by day, for reading
formats.csv: CSV — one row per transcript, for spreadsheets

export.verifiedOnly: Only transcripts I corrected by hand
export.prunedByCount: Handy Plus is keeping only your {{n}} most recent transcripts — older ones have already been deleted and cannot be exported. Star transcripts to keep them, or raise the limit in History settings.
export.prunedByAge: Handy Plus deletes transcripts older than your retention setting, so anything past it is already gone and cannot be exported.
export.trainingNote: Contains phrase corrections you have made, plus whole-transcript pairs for anything you correct from now on. Transcripts corrected before this feature existed cannot be paired — the original text was not kept.
export.done: Exported {{transcripts}} transcripts ({{pairs}} training pairs, {{corrections}} phrase corrections).

history.audioNotSaved: Audio not saved for this entry
history.editError: Failed to save your edit. Please try again.
history.teachPrompt: Teach Handy Plus that "{{wrong}}" should be "{{correct}}"?

insights.title: Usage Insights
insights.empty: No dictation yet for this period.
insights.footnote: Counted on your Mac from your own history, and kept even after old transcripts are cleared.

updateChecks.description: Automatically check for new versions of Handy Plus

keyboardDiagnostic.description: Checks whether keyboard events reach Handy Plus. Only event counts are recorded — never which keys you press.
keyboardDiagnostic.verdictOk: Key events are reaching Handy Plus normally.

doubleMetaphoneMatching.label: Double Metaphone matching
doubleMetaphoneMatching.description: Use Double Metaphone instead of Soundex to match custom words by sound. More accurate on names, but it changes which words clear the correction threshold — measure before leaving it on.

whatsNewUpdates.description: Show release notes after Handy Plus updates

whatsNewHistory.title: What's New
whatsNewHistory.description: See what changed in each released version, newest first

appDataDirectory.description: Location where Handy Plus stores its data

ggml.details: Handy Plus's local speech-to-text is built on transcribe.cpp and ggml. Thanks to the amazing work by Georgi Gerganov and contributors.

suggestions.title: Suggested corrections
suggestions.description: Corrections you have made more than once. Accepting one applies it automatically from now on.
suggestions.empty: Nothing yet. When you fix a transcript in History and the same fix comes up again, it will appear here ready to accept.

learning.title: Still learning
learning.description: Fixes seen once. Make the same one again and it moves up to be accepted — waiting for a second sighting is what stops a typo becoming a permanent rule.

candidates.title: Words you use often
candidates.description: Names and terms found in your past transcripts. Adding one tells the model to listen for it.
candidates.empty: Nothing to suggest yet — this fills in as you dictate.

words.title: Custom words
words.description: Words and names to listen for.

whatsNew.title: New in Handy Plus v{{version}}
whatsNew.historyEmpty: No release notes are bundled with this build yet.

accessibility.permissionsDescription: Handy Plus needs accessibility permissions to type transcribed text.

appLanguage.description: Change the language of the Handy Plus interface

theme.description: Choose whether Handy Plus follows your system theme or stays light or dark
